observed_behavior: The publication fixture was rejected as dirty before mainline preparation; Git status reported untracked node_modules.
expected_behavior: The fixture dependency link is ignored while ordinary user work remains protected by the clean-checkout precondition.
causal_mechanism: The trailing slash in /node_modules/ matches a directory; the fixture used a symlink, which Git treats as a file entry.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Using a directory-only ignore pattern for a fixture resource whose physical kind is a symlink.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: The intended resource remains untracked and makes the real preservation check correctly refuse publication.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Fixture ignore rules match the actual resource kind without weakening production preservation checks.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Use /node_modules without the trailing slash and retain an explicit clean fixture precondition.

applicability_conditions: A fixture links dependencies by symlink.
Git ignores are directory-only while publication requires a clean checkout.
confirmation_evidence: The bounded Git-status assertion reported exactly ?? node_modules before preparation.
After correcting the ignore pattern, the real Git/full-QA Arc passes without changing the production clean-checkout guard.
regression_proofs: tests/rolling-publication.integration.test.ts: mainline candidate preserves published campaign history and requires complete full QA on its exact merged tree
